learned: Skill Studio has separate normalize, synchronize, and validate stages, but the open path invokes only normalize. Default capability.json also omits the revision version. A dedicated preparation boundary can synchronize valid files while preserving malformed files for visible repair.
next_action: Add a bounded candidate-preparation helper, use it on every skill editor open, add exact unit coverage, and retain the browser interaction as end-to-end evidence.

evidence.claim: The defect is registered before repair.
The editor open path invokes normalizeSkill without identity synchronization.
The existing synchronization function is submit-time only and can reject malformed capability JSON.
